question: Should Dreaming localization be a supported memory-core config surface now, and should it cover fixed structural labels only, narrative language hints, custom templates, prompt overrides, or a narrower subset?
rationale: The request adds new public plugin config and generated artifact semantics, and repository policy treats new config surfaces as product and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Review the linked PR against a narrow contract
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101323 as the implementation candidate if maintainers want fixed-label Dreaming Journal i18n now.

options.title: Consolidate under the broader tracker
options.body: Close or redirect this issue only after preserving the useful context under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79223 if maintainers want one canonical language/prompt design thread.

options.title: Defer Dreaming i18n
options.body: Keep the current English structural labels until maintainers choose a wider localization strategy for generated memory artifacts.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR against a narrow contract
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101323 as the implementation candidate if maintainers want fixed-label Dreaming Journal i18n now.
